The OpenAI catalog now defaults to GPT-6.1 Sol, with its supported reasoning levels and $0.10 per million cached input tokens. Codex HTTP and WebSocket requests use client version 0.159.1.

Before restarting an existing gateway, update saved `gpt-6-sol` provider selections and Bot routes to `gpt-6.1-sol`. Replace `none` reasoning with a supported level such as `medium`. Gateway protocol 88 is unchanged.
